title: Tagged ranges versus exact replacement under ambiguity and stale state
hypothesis: Tagged line ranges will require fewer recovery turns for repeated text and will reject stale target lines at least as reliably as exact oldText/newText replacement.
falsified_if: Exact replacement matches or exceeds tagged deterministic pass rate on both scenarios without materially more failed mutations, model calls, response size, or latency.
decision_rule: Reject a format on any repeatable loss of the requested change, concurrent annotation, or scope control. If both remain correct, prefer the format with fewer recovery/model calls and lower response size across both scenarios. Combine these results with existing_codebase_edit before changing production; do not choose from a single scenario average.
measurement_amendment: One exact stale-recovery run created .pytest_cache by running pytest before the documented unittest command. Its requested edit, injected annotation, and behavior were correct. Generated interpreter/test-runner caches are now excluded from scope grading; the invalid cell is replaced with a fresh run.
